전도서 1:1.content: The words of the Preacher, the son of David, king in Jerusalem.

전도서 1:2.content: Vanity of vanities, saith the Preacher, vanity of vanities; all is vanity.

전도서 1:3.content: What profit hath a man of all his labour which he taketh under the sun?

전도서 1:4.content: One generation passeth away, and another generation cometh: but the earth abideth for ever.

전도서 1:5.content: The sun also ariseth, and the sun goeth down, and hasteth to his place where he arose.

전도서 1:6.content: The wind goeth toward the south, and turneth about unto the north; it whirleth about continually, and the wind returneth again according to his circuits.

전도서 1:7.content: All the rivers run into the sea; yet the sea is not full; unto the place from whence the rivers come, thither they return again.

전도서 1:8.content: All things are full of labour; man cannot utter it: the eye is not satisfied with seeing, nor the ear filled with hearing.

전도서 1:9.content: The thing that hath been, it is that which shall be; and that which is done is that which shall be done: and there is no new thing under the sun.

전도서 1:10.content: Is there any thing whereof it may be said, See, this is new? it hath been already of old time, which was before us.

전도서 1:11.content: There is no remembrance of former things; neither shall there be any remembrance of things that are to come with those that shall come after.

전도서 1:12.content: I the Preacher was king over Israel in Jerusalem.

전도서 1:13.content: And I gave my heart to seek and search out by wisdom concerning all things that are done under heaven: this sore travail hath God given to the sons of man to be exercised therewith.

전도서 1:14.content: I have seen all the works that are done under the sun; and, behold, all is vanity and vexation of spirit.

전도서 1:15.content: That which is crooked cannot be made straight: and that which is wanting cannot be numbered.

전도서 1:16.content: I communed with mine own heart, saying, Lo, I am come to great estate, and have gotten more wisdom than all they that have been before me in Jerusalem: yea, my heart had great experience of wisdom and knowledge.

전도서 1:17.content: And I gave my heart to know wisdom, and to know madness and folly: I perceived that this also is vexation of spirit.

전도서 1:18.content: For in much wisdom is much grief: and he that increaseth knowledge increaseth sorrow.
